title: Garment Industry
description: Advanced ERP solutions tailored for garment manufacturers, streamlining production processes from design to delivery while optimizing style management, costing and quality control.

infoCards.title: Style Control
infoCards.description: Complete style lifecycle management from design to production with detailed specifications tracking.

infoCards.title: Quality Check
infoCards.description: End-to-end quality control system for garment manufacturing with defect management.

faqData.question: How does the system manage different styles and sizes?
faqData.answer: Our system provides comprehensive style management with size-wise planning, color variations, sample tracking and detailed specifications management for each style variant.

faqData.question: What production tracking features are included?
faqData.answer: The system includes real-time production tracking with line efficiency monitoring, worker productivity analysis and detailed cost tracking for each production stage.

faqData.question: Can it handle material planning and costing?
faqData.answer: Yes, our solution manages detailed material requirements planning, consumption analysis, cost calculations and wastage tracking for optimal resource utilization.
